fields.Trigger: Court order, subpoena, or regulatory e-Discovery request

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Legal parses request scope" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews for privilege" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Legal produces responsive records in required format" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-495 (ensure controlled execution — Records Compliance, e-Discovery & BIR/SEC/NPC Audit (PA-88.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Legal risk**: Incomplete production or broken chain of custody; mitigated by defensible process and documentation
System Touchpoints: - e-Discovery collection tool; chain-of-custody log; privilege log

steps.activity: Legal parses request scope (custodians, date range, keywords, record classes); coordinates with Records Manager/IT
IT/Records Manager collects relevant ESI (electronically stored information) preserving metadata and chain of custody; de-duplicates and reviews for privilege
Legal produces responsive records in required format; documents privilege log; archives production

fields.Trigger: BIR Letter of Authority covering books/records

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager to assemble books, e-books, invoices, schedules for 10-year…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System continuous audit of "Tax Manager/Legal responds to BIR queries" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-495 (ensure controlled execution — Records Compliance, e-Discovery & BIR/SEC/NPC Audit (PA-88.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Incomplete/unavailable records trigger BIR assessment; mitigated by 10-year retention and retrieval readiness
System Touchpoints: - BIR audit production repository; chain-of-custody log

steps.activity: Tax Manager validates LOA scope; coordinates with Records Manager to assemble books, e-books, invoices, schedules for 10-year look-back
Records Manager produces records (digital preferred; physical where required) in BIR-accepted format; maintains inventory and chain of custody
Tax Manager/Legal responds to BIR queries; defends record completeness and integrity; archives audit correspondence

workflows.name: SEC Corporate Records Filing & Inspection Support

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Corp Sec maintains SEC corporate records" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "files SEC-required forms" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "inspection/inquiry by producing corporate records on demand" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-495 (ensure controlled execution — Records Compliance, e-Discovery & BIR/SEC/NPC Audit (PA-88.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Late/incomplete SEC filings incur penalty; mitigated by filing calendar and retention
System Touchpoints: - SEC iACES portal; corporate records repository

steps.activity: Corp Sec maintains SEC corporate records: articles, bylaws, board/stockholder minutes, secretary's certificate, GIS, AFS
Corp Sec files SEC-required forms (GIS, AFS, material disclosures) via SEC Express/iACES; archives confirmation
Records Manager supports SEC inspection/inquiry by producing corporate records on demand

fields.Trigger: NPC complaint, investigation, or compliance check

workflows.name: NPC Data Privacy Audit & Records Production

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "DPO maintains Data Privacy Act records" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "updates privacy program" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-495 (ensure controlled execution — Records Compliance, e-Discovery & BIR/SEC/NPC Audit (PA-88.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Inadequate privacy records incur NPC sanction; mitigated by continuous documentation
System Touchpoints: - Data privacy records repository; NPC submission; breach register

steps.activity: DPO maintains Data Privacy Act records: DPIAs, consent records, data processing inventory, breach register, registration (DPS)
DPO produces records in response to NPC inquiry/complaint; demonstrates compliance with privacy principles and retention rules
Legal/DPO defends position; implements any NPC order; updates privacy program; archives outcome

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager assembles DOLE-required records" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "HR produces records for DOLE inspector" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "Legal/HR addresses any DOLE findings" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-495 (ensure controlled execution — Records Compliance, e-Discovery & BIR/SEC/NPC Audit (PA-88.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Missing records trigger DOLE finding; mitigated by retention and retrieval readiness
System Touchpoints: - HR records repository; DOLE inspection tracker; CAP repository

steps.activity: HR/Records Manager assembles DOLE-required records: payroll, 201 files, contracts, attendance, CBA, DO 174 (for outsourced), OHS, working conditions
HR produces records for DOLE inspector; supports inspection walkthrough; documents findings
Legal/HR addresses any DOLE findings; implements corrective action; archives inspection outcome

workflows.name: Litigation Records Management & Chain of Custody

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records relevant to matter" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation for each collected record" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "Legal authenticates records for court/arbitration" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-495 (ensure controlled execution — Records Compliance, e-Discovery & BIR/SEC/NPC Audit (PA-88.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Evidentiary risk**: Broken chain of custody undermines admissibility; mitigated by rigorous documentation
System Touchpoints: - Chain-of-custody log; matter file; authentication evidence

steps.activity: Legal identifies records relevant to matter; coordinates preservation (legal hold) and collection
Records Manager/IT maintains chain-of-custody documentation for each collected record (who, when, hash)
Legal authenticates records for court/arbitration; defends admissibility; archives matter file post-resolution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records by class" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "Records Manager/Compliance develop Corrective Action Plan" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-495 (ensure controlled execution — Records Compliance, e-Discovery & BIR/SEC/NPC Audit (PA-88.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Unidentified records gaps; mitigated by annual audit and CAP
System Touchpoints: - Audit evidence; CSA tracker; CAP repository

steps.activity: Internal Audit samples records by class; validates classification, metadata, retention compliance, and access control
Records Manager performs control self-assessment; identifies gaps (mis-classification, missing metadata, access anomalies)
Records Manager/Compliance develop Corrective Action Plan; tracks remediation; reports closure to Audit Committee

workflows.name: Records Management KPI, Cost & Maturity Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager compiles KPIs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "tracks records management cost" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports roadmap to Executive Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-495 (ensure controlled execution — Records Compliance, e-Discovery & BIR/SEC/NPC Audit (PA-88.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Strategic risk**: Stagnant program raises cost and risk; mitigated by maturity assessment and roadmap
System Touchpoints: - KPI dashboard; cost analytics; maturity model

steps.activity: Records Manager compiles KPIs: capture rate, metadata completeness, retrieval time, disposition timeliness, audit findings
Finance tracks records management cost (storage, vendor, system, labor); benchmarks vs. industry
Records Manager assesses program maturity annually (digitization, automation, governance); reports roadmap to Executive Committee
